verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms ernd serves an llms.txt at https://ernd.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its content is agent-readable: a product summary, partner perk details, and a consolidated list of ernd guides that an agent can be pointed at. missing for 10: evidence of deeper agent-oriented docs beyond the llms.txt index (e.g., an llms-full.txt or markdown guide bodies), and independent corroboration of how well agents use it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
